text:
The range of audible frequencies for elephants is 10Hz to 12000Hz, and for horses is 55Hz to
33000Hz.
Which statement about the range of audible frequencies for a healthy human ear is correct?
A
The human ear can hear all sounds heard by both elephants and horses.
B
The human ear can hear all sounds heard by elephants but not all those heard by horses.
C
The human ear can hear all sounds heard by horses but not all those heard by elephants.
D
The human ear cannot hear all sounds heard by elephants nor those heard by horses.

options.label: A
options.text: The human ear can hear all sounds heard by both elephants and horses.

options.label: B
options.text: The human ear can hear all sounds heard by elephants but not all those heard by horses.

options.label: C
options.text: The human ear can hear all sounds heard by horses but not all those heard by elephants.

options.label: D
options.text: The human ear cannot hear all sounds heard by elephants nor those heard by horses.
